health_centers.method: Mapped, eligible HRSA sites whose published coordinates fall inside the area boundary (2024 TIGER, or 119th Congress district).
limitations: Sites without usable published coordinates, and locations HRSA suppresses, are not counted.
A site listing is not a service area, capacity, or travel-time measure.
health_centers.name: HRSA Health Center Service Delivery and Look-Alike Sites

nursing_homes.method: CMS nursing homes whose published address coordinates fall inside the area boundary (2024 TIGER, or 119th Congress district).
limitations: Facilities with ZIP-based coordinates (CMS geocoding footnote) are not counted.
Certified beds are not vacancies. Star ratings are not averaged and are not a live care assessment.
A missing overall rating means unrated, not zero.
nursing_homes.name: CMS Nursing Home Provider Information

tri_facilities.method: EPA TRI reporting facilities whose coordinates fall inside the area boundary (county: the spatially derived county stored at publication).
limitations: Reporting to TRI does not mean a release occurred, a violation, a health risk, or current operation.
Facilities below reporting thresholds or outside covered sectors do not appear; absence is not absence of pollution.
tri_facilities.name: EPA Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) reporting facilities
